campaign_brief.objective: Generate 15 qualified demos (SQL-level opportunities) from CISO personas at mid-market SaaS companies via account-based marketing on LinkedIn
campaign_brief.target_audience: Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs) at Series B-D SaaS/tech companies (100-1000 employees) in US, excluding existing customers and competitors
campaign_brief.success_metric: Cost per qualified lead (MQL to SQL conversion)

ab_test_plan.control_description: DataShield prevents insider threats in your Salesforce (feature-focused, neutral tone)
ab_test_plan.variant_description: Insider threats cost companies $15.4M average. DataShield stops them. (problem-driven, urgency-focused)

launch_checklist.item: Create control LinkedIn ad copy and creative (neutral positioning)
Create variant LinkedIn ad copy and creative (urgency positioning)
Build landing page with lead form (email, company, title required fields)
Set up LinkedIn campaign in Campaign Manager (audience, bidding, tracking pixels)
Test landing page and lead form; ensure CRM integration working
Set up analytics dashboard for daily monitoring
Launch campaign and monitor first 24 hours

metrics_to_monitor: Daily spend vs. budget pace ($400/day target)
Click-through rate (CTR %) for both control and variant
Lead quality score (form completeness, intent signals)

alert_thresholds.action: Alert: spent more than budget pace. Investigate bidding settings.
Alert: CPL is 2x target. Review lead quality and conversion rate.
CRITICAL: CPL exceeds kill threshold. Pause campaign immediately and escalate.
Alert: CTR below 2.5% benchmark. Ad creative may be underperforming.
Alert: Conversion rate below 5% target. Review form friction.

daily_monitoring_plan.pause_criteria: Campaign is PAUSED immediately if: (1) CPL exceeds $800 for 7 consecutive days, (2) impressions drop to zero (platform issue), (3) data integration breaks and conversions cannot be tracked
daily_monitoring_plan.escalation_process: Pause alert sent to Growth-Experimenter within 1 hour of threshold breach. If CRITICAL alert (CPL >$1000), pause campaign immediately and escalate to Weekly-Governance-Agent for decision on continuation or pivot.

reporting_cadence.daily_snapshot: End-of-day dashboard review: spend, impressions, CTR, conversion rate, CPL for each variant
reporting_cadence.weekly_review: Every Monday 10am: compare control vs. variant performance, assess statistical significance, recommend scaling/pausing
